title: Vanish Surreal Scene
description: A surreal landscape features a woman with a skull face and black bob haircut sitting on an ornate mechanical device by the water, holding a glowing orange orb. In the background, a large orange pyramid topped with a gothic cathedral displays the word 'VANISH' in colorful letters, surrounded by purple bubbly clouds, a grey alien, flying eyeballs, a red sun, and a starry sky with meteors.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene with a skull-faced woman in a pink shirt sitting on a mechanical platform by the shore, holding a glowing orange sphere. Behind her is a massive orange Mayan pyramid with a dark gothic cathedral on top spelling the word VANISH in multicolored letters. Purple bubbly clouds float across the sky containing small trees and eyeballs, a small grey alien stands on the right, a red sun and shooting stars appear in the dark sky, turquoise water with floating eyeballs and a tiny pyramid, mystical and bizarre atmosphere.
